snip.t: The standard regimen for drug-susceptible TB is a 6-month course:
Chemotherapy: R-CHOP (Rituximab, Cyclophosphamide, Doxorubicin, Vincristine, Prednisolone) is the standard regimen for DLBCL.
Rifampicin: Anti-TB drug — Tuberculous pleural effusion, as part of the standard regimen — Hepatitis, orange urine, many interactions
Improved survival with early detection + access to standard regimens (e.g. childhood ALL, testicular cancer – highly curable even in resource-limited settings if treated properly)
Standard regimen (RIPE): Rifampin + Isoniazid + Pyrazinamide + Ethambutol × 2 months, then Rifampin + Isoniazid × 4 months (total 6 months)
| M. bovis | Bovine TB | Standard regimen — NOT pyrazinamide (intrinsically resistant) |
Standard Regimen - 2 months intensive phase: Rifampicin + Isoniazid + Pyrazinamide + Ethambutol - 4 months continuation phase: Rifampicin + Isoniazid - Total = 6 months
